services.name: cpu_check
services.description: Check CPU usage, load average, and top processes on a fleet host over SSH.

host.description: Fleet host to check: hostname, IP, or [user@]host.

services.name: disk_check
services.description: Check disk space usage on a fleet host over SSH.

host.description: Fleet host to check: hostname, IP, or [user@]host.

services.name: restart_fleet_mcp
services.description: Restart the fleet-mcp systemd service on this machine. Needed after fleet_mcp.py itself changes; plain services.json edits only need reload_services. Returns immediately; the restart happens a couple seconds later, so wait a few seconds before the next tool call.
